sources.entry: Xcodes - Install and switch between multiple versions of Xcode. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon] ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]](https://github.com/RobotsAndPencils/XcodesApp)
Xcodes.app - The easiest way to install and switch between multiple versions of Xcode.

summary.one_liner: Xcodes.app is a macOS app for installing and switching between multiple versions of Xcode, with a command-line companion called xcodes.
summary.what_it_does: Lists available Xcode versions from Xcode Releases' data or the Apple Developer website. Installs chosen Xcode versions with downloads via aria2 (up to 16 connections) and automatically resumes after network errors. Makes an installed version active with xcode-select via a button click. Shows release notes, OS compatibility, and included SDKs and compilers from Xcode Releases. Also supports installing Platforms/Runtimes (iOS, tvOS, watchOS, visionOS) and Apple Silicon or Universal variants. Requires an Apple ID to download Xcode.
use_cases: Install multiple Xcode versions side by side
Switch the active Xcode version on a Mac
Download Xcode without the Mac App Store
Install iOS, watchOS, or visionOS simulator runtimes
Pick Apple Silicon or Universal Xcode builds
how_to_run: Alternatively, download the Xcodes.zip asset from the GitHub releases page
Development build requires macOS 15.6 and Xcode 26
notable: Uses aria2 with up to 16 connections for faster Xcode downloads
Installs and activates runtimes like iOS, tvOS, watchOS and visionOS from within the app
Localized into many languages through community contributions
Available through Homebrew as a signed and notarized cask
caveats: Requires an Apple ID to download Xcode versions
Runtime installs for iOS 18+, tvOS 18+, watchOS 11+, visionOS 2+ need Xcode 16.1 Beta 3+ installed and active; Apple Silicon runtime variants need Xcode 26 active
Version 1.x needs macOS 11, 2.x and 3.x need macOS 13; building needs macOS 15.6 and Xcode 26
